Panel.MixedContent: Blocked: this page is served over HTTPS, so the browser will not allow a connection to a remote Audio Forge. Use http:// for Foundry or run Audio Forge on this computer.

Host.Name: Audio Forge host
Host.Hint: Where Audio Forge runs, as seen from this browser. Usually localhost.

Port.Name: Local API port
Port.Hint: Audio Forge: Settings > Local API. Default 8329.

ApiKey.Name: API key
ApiKey.Hint: Only needed when Audio Forge is on another machine. The Local API is plain HTTP, so use a trusted network.

RoomsServer.Name: Rooms server
RoomsServer.Hint: Where Audio Forge opens online rooms. Leave the default unless you run your own server.

RoomAutoOpen.Name: Open the online room while players are connected
RoomAutoOpen.Hint: GM only. Opens an online room when the first player connects and closes it a minute after the last one leaves, unless someone else is still in the room. A room you open yourself is never closed for you. Turn off to open and close it yourself.

RoomAutoJoin.Name: Join the room automatically
RoomAutoJoin.Hint: Start listening as soon as the GM opens an online room.

AutoScene.Name: Apply scene audio on activation
AutoScene.Hint: When a scene is activated, run the audio profile configured for it.

AutoCombat.Name: Apply combat audio
AutoCombat.Hint: Run the combat start and combat end profiles below.

Profile.Title: Audio profile: {name}
Profile.StopMusic: Stop music if none is picked
Profile.OfflineHint: Audio Forge is offline, so the lists are empty. Saved choices are kept.

Notify.EchoScreen: Audio Forge did not start the echo within 10 seconds. If this keeps happening, try playing it once from the Audio Forge app.

Room.NeedsAudioForge: Connect to Audio Forge first: the room is opened from the Audio Forge app on this computer.
Room.OpenHint: Players in this world join automatically and hear your Audio Forge output. Nobody needs the link.
Room.WaitingHint: Players marked as waiting were turned away because the room is full. Remove someone, then connect them.
Room.FullFree: The room is full. Free rooms have a listener limit. Subscribe to Audio Forge in the app to remove it.
Room.RejectedGM: {name} could not join the Audio Forge room: it is full ({max} listeners).
Room.RejectedGMFree: {name} could not join the Audio Forge room: it is full ({max} listeners). Subscribe to Audio Forge in the app to remove the limit.
Room.RejectedPlayer: The room is full. Your GM can free a slot for you.
Room.Removed: The GM removed you from the room.
Room.JoinError: Could not join the room. Ask your GM to check the room password.
Room.NoRoom: Your GM has not opened a room.
Room.PlayerPromo: Like what you hear? Audio Forge is free to download.
